adminStatus.description: Administrative status: A (active) or C (ceased) — 'active' and 'ceased' are also accepted.
adminStatus.title: Administrative status

departement.description: French département of the head office (siège), e.g. 75 (Paris), 69 (Rhône), 2A (Corse-du-Sud), 971 (Guadeloupe).
departement.title: Département (siège)

hasSiege.description: Only return legal units whose head-office (siège) location could be attached from the same stock.
hasSiege.title: Only units with a siège location

legalForm.description: Exact 4-digit catégorie juridique code, e.g. 5710 (SAS), 5499 (SARL), 9220 (association déclarée).
legalForm.title: Legal form code (catégorie juridique)

legalFormGroup.description: First digit of the catégorie juridique code (sociétés are 5, associations are 9, public bodies are spread over 4–8). Group 1 (sole traders / personnes physiques) is not in this archive.
legalFormGroup.title: Legal form group (1 digit)

limit.description: Maximum rows pushed to the dataset. Leave empty to return all matching rows.
limit.title: Max rows returned

mode.description: rows = matching legal-unit rows to the dataset; analytics = derived analytics to the key-value store (record ANALYTICS); both = both.
mode.title: Mode

monthFrom.description: Earliest creation month to include, YYYY-MM. Prefilled with the snapshot's latest month so a default run returns just the new-creations cohort.
monthFrom.title: Creation month from

monthTo.description: Latest creation month to include, YYYY-MM.
monthTo.title: Creation month to

nafCode.description: Prefix match on the NAF/APE activity code; dots are ignored, e.g. 62.01, 6201 or 47 both work.
nafCode.title: NAF/APE code prefix

nafDivision.description: Two-digit NAF division, matched as a prefix on the activity code, e.g. 62 (computer programming), 47 (retail), 86 (health).
nafDivision.title: NAF division (2-digit)

nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the legal unit's name.
nameContains.title: Name contains

onlyNewThisMonth.description: Restrict to legal units created in the snapshot's latest creation month (the new-creations cohort), ignoring monthFrom/monthTo.
onlyNewThisMonth.title: Only the latest month's new creations
